cases.condition: Review 1 reports findings A, B, and C; only A has been repaired and validated.
expected: Do not intentionally start merge-acceptance review 2 yet.
B and C remain in the known material finding backlog.
Each remaining finding requires current-head validated repair or evidence-backed no-change disposition plus required closure evidence before reacquisition.
The closure-evidence prerequisite is owned by canonical pull-request policy; procedure and provider guidance only implement or represent it.

cases.condition: A material actionable finding exists only in a review summary/body and has no resolvable inline thread.
expected: Keep an independently identifiable finding locator.
Run the same disposition and current-head validation process as for inline findings.
Record closure evidence on an available durable review or pull-request surface.

cases.condition: A reviewer finding is falsified by the current exact head and applicable authority, but its no-change disposition has not yet been validated and recorded as closed.
expected: Keep the falsified finding in the unresolved backlog until validated no-change disposition and closure evidence are recorded.
Do not create an appeasement mutation.
Record decisive evidence, current-head validation, and durable closure evidence before treating the finding as semantically closed.

cases.condition: Several currently known verified compatible findings require head-changing repairs.
expected: Combine the compatible repairs into one coherent mutation batch before intentionally reacquiring expensive exact-head evidence.
Keep unrelated or authority-conflicting repairs separate.
Any proposed-head change invalidates exact-head CI and review for the former commit; reuse only other evidence whose binding genuinely did not change.

cases.condition: S1 is not stable, S2 can be implemented without embedding the unresolved S1 assumption, and S3 final immutable identity depends on the eventual S1 SHA.
expected: Allow dependency-safe S2 implementation to continue despite review latency.
Defer S3 final immutable identity materialization until the upstream identity is stable enough to bind.
Do not deliberately propagate a known material defect or manufacture knowingly stale final provenance.

cases.condition: Implementation and required validation are complete, the known finding backlog is empty, final exact heads are stable, and the task explicitly authorizes one final whole-stack audit.
expected: Request one final diagnostic whole-stack review after exact-head required CI succeeds.
Do not treat the audit as per-member merge-acceptance evidence or merge authorization.

Unless the explicit task requires the diagnostic audit to complete before handoff, do not wait for the result; do not retry review or merge, and stop at HANDOFF_READY when the completion contract permits handoff.
